## SqliteGrammar.incrementsSql() method

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

`integer not null primary key autoincrement` — the only spelling sqlite treats as a rowid alias, so the type stays `integer` even for a big key.
